// Suggested section: == iOS system alerts in automation sessions

- Automation sessions on iOS and iPadOS can now interact with system alerts that iOS shows on top of an app, such as the alert that asks you to turn on Location Services. Scripts can locate a button on the alert, read its `displayed` and `enabled` properties, and click it. Previously, these commands failed with a `No active application elements` error and the alert stayed open. Behavior for elements inside apps, including iPad apps in multi-window mode, is unchanged.
